From: Maya Singh <maya@bluepeak.ai>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-25T16:12:00-08:00
Subject: Discovery call recap + request for technical deep dive

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the call earlier today — helpful overview of Redwood’s runtime and cost/levers. Quick recap from our side: BluePeak’s goals are faster query turnaround for our analytics assistant, cut per-token inference cost for batch reranks, and a path for private deployment for sensitive datasets.

We’d like to follow up with a 60–90 minute technical deep dive focused on:
- model/quantization options for our workloads
- expected latency at the 1–2k qps profile
- network/integration constraints for a VPC/on-prem rollout

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue, Dec 1: 10:00–12:00
- Wed, Dec 2: 09:00–11:30
- Thu, Dec 3: 13:00–15:00

Attendees from our side who should join: Luis Gonzalez (Product, luis@bluepeak.ai) and Priya Rao (Infrastructure, priya@bluepeak.ai). We may also loop in one of our security contacts if there are relevant items to cover.

Two quick asks before the deep dive:
1) Can you share any pre-read or notes from today?
2) Do you prefer Zoom or Google Meet for the session?

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

—Maya
Maya Singh
Head of Product, BluePeak Analytics

Great to hear — glad the call was productive. Attaching a short discovery notes PDF that pulls together the key items we discussed (workload profile, initial cost levers, and questions to drive the deep dive).

For the deep dive, Ben (solutions) and Soojin (platform) will lead the technical session. From our side we recommend a 75-minute workshop: 45 min deep technical review + 20 min targeted Q&A + 10 min next-step alignment.

Of the windows you listed, we can do:
- Wed, Dec 2, 10:00–11:15 PT
- Thu, Dec 3, 13:00–14:15 PT

Which of those works best? Also fine with Zoom or Meet — Ben, can you confirm which you prefer and whether you’ll host?

Thanks,
